criteria.rationale: The patient was 28 years old on the request date, exceeding the minimum age of 12.
The PA request identifies chronic weight management as the indication, and the requested Wegovy order is for that treatment.
The August 11 note documents continued diet, exercise, and program coaching. It is within 180 days of the request.
The latest structured BMI is 29.7, below 30 but above the alternative cutoff of 27. No qualifying weight-related comorbidity is documented to establish eligibility under that alternative.

missing_requirements: Documentation of a qualifying weight-related comorbidity for BMI 27–29.9.
parsed.summary: Age, indication, and ongoing lifestyle modification meet policy requirements. The latest BMI is 29.7; eligibility at this BMI requires a documented weight-related comorbidity, which the supplied evidence does not establish.
